statements.quote: Adobe is the leader in the AI creative applications category with AI-influenced ARR surpassing $5 billion and AI-first ARR already exceeding our $250 million year-end target,” said Shantanu Narayen, chair and CEO, Adobe.
statements.notes: This is annual recurring revenue (ARR) at the end of Q3 FY25, not recognized revenue. 'Surpassing' means $5B is a floor. 'AI-influenced' is a broad metric: it counts ARR from products that include AI features, not revenue from AI alone.
